plugins.description: Claude Code skills from Annetaan Inc. Holds workflow, which runs one implementation as design, approval, per-task implement and review rounds, an integration review when there is more than one task, and a finish step that can open a pull request. Also pj1-plan, pj2-doctor and pj3-running, which run a larger piece of work as a project on GitHub, from a split into issues through decisions you tick on GitHub and a review of the whole project to one merged pull request per issue. And doc-write, which writes a document in plain words that says each thing once and in order, and doc-meta, doc-review and doc-revise, which let you flag sentences in a document with an opinion and have the document revised to match.
